**Indikator 4a** is a central clinical quality indicator in the Danish healthcare system, designed to measure the proportion of patients diagnosed with [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] who receive [[antikoagulationsbehandling|antikoagulationsbehandling]] at 1, 2, and 5 years post-diagnosis, provided they have a clinical indication for it [^src1] [^src4] [^src5]. Managed by the [[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] (RKKP) as part of the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]], the indicator serves as a critical safety metric aimed at preventing thromboembolic complications, such as strokes, in vulnerable patient populations [^src1] [^src5].

The clinical indication for anticoagulation under this indicator is defined by a [[cha2ds2-vasc|CHA2DS2-VASc]] score of ≥2 [^src5]. To calculate the indicator, data is cross-referenced from the [[landspatientregisteret|Landspatientregisteret]] and the [[laegemiddelstatistikregisteret|Lægemiddelstatistikregisteret]] [^src5]. The established performance standard for Indikator 4a is that at least 90% of the indicated patient population should be receiving treatment ([[standard-90-percent|Standard: ≥90 %]]) [^src1] [^src3] [^src4].

During the reporting period from July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, national performance hovered just around or slightly below the target depending on the time elapsed since diagnosis [^src1] [^src3] [^src4]. At the 1-year mark, the national average in [[danmark|Danmark]] was 89.6% [^src1]. At the 2-year mark, the national average remained at 89.6% [^src3]. By the 5-year mark, the national average dipped to 87.7% [^src4]. Regional disparities were notable: [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] consistently performed well, being the only region to meet the ≥90% standard at the 5-year mark with a rate of 92.4% [^src4], while also achieving 92.7% at the 2-year mark [^src3]. [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] met the standard at the 2-year mark with 90.5% [^src3].

At the hospital level, performance varied significantly. [[regionshospital-nordjylland-ven|Regionshospital Nordjylland Ven]] emerged as a top performer, recording the highest share among all units at the 2-year mark (93.6%) [^src3]. Conversely, institutions like [[garantiklinikken|Garantiklinikken]] (53.8% at 2 years) and [[kolding-sygehus|Kolding Sygehus]] (71.1% at 5 years) fell significantly short of the target [^src3] [^src4]. [[rigshospitalet|Rigshospitalet]] also struggled to meet the standard, recording 79.7% at the 5-year mark [^src4]. Despite these localized shortfalls, long-term trend observations indicate a continuous increase in target fulfillment at 1, 2, and 5 years, reaching the highest levels recorded to date, with a steady rise in treatment persistence observed since 2016 [^src5].

## Timeline

- 1. juli 2022: Start af indberetningsperioden for Indikator 3 og Indikator 4a i Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark (indikator-3, indikator-4a, databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark)
- 30. juni 2023: Afslutning af indberetningsperioden for Indikator 3 og Indikator 4a i Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark (indikator-3, indikator-4a, databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark)
- 2022-07-01: Start af rapporteringsperioden for Indikator 4a: 1. juli 2022 – 30. juni 2023 (indikator-4a)
- 2023-06-30: Afslutning af rapporteringsperioden for Indikator 4a: 1. juli 2022 – 30. juni 2023 (indikator-4a)
- 2022-07-01: Start af rapportperioden for Indikator 4a (indikator-4a)
- 2023-06-30: Afslutning af rapportperioden for Indikator 4a (indikator-4a)
- 2016: Start på observation af stigende persistens til antikoagulationsbehandling (indikator-4a)
- 2021-07-01: Start af måleperiode for indikator 4a (01.07.2021–30.06.2022) (indikator-4a)
- 2022-06-30: Slut på måleperiode for indikator 4a (01.07.2021–30.06.2022) (indikator-4a)
